items.raw_excerpt: 4月5日， 金沢大学の課外活動団体である金沢大学ボランティアさぽーとステーションの学生と，同団体顧問で人間社会研究域経済学経営学系の原田魁成講師は，輪島市で行われた重蔵神社春祭に参加しました。同祭り
items.summary_en: Kanazawa University students from the volunteer support station joined the Chuzo Shrine spring festival in Wajima City on April 5. Lecturer Kaisei Harada from the university also took part. The students joined the local festival together with local people.
items.summary_ko: 가나자와 대학 자원봉사 서포트 스테이션 소속 학생들이 4월 5일 와지마시에서 열린 주조 신사 봄 축제에 참여했습니다. 대학 경제학·경영학계의 하라다 가이세이 강사도 함께했습니다. 학생들은 지역 주민들과 함께 축제에 함께했습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: People with German ancestry may qualify to reclaim their citizenship rights in certain cases. But like the process for naturalising via residency, first they have to submit a comprehensive application – and then potentially wait for years.
items.summary_en: People with German ancestors may be able to get German citizenship again in some cases. But first they must send a full application. Then they may have to wait for years.
items.summary_ko: 독일 출신 조상이 있는 사람은 어떤 경우에는 시민권을 되찾을 수 있습니다. 하지만 거주를 통한 귀화와 마찬가지로 먼저 서류 신청을 해야 하며, 그 후에도 몇 년을 기다려야 할 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Applying for German citizenship through ancestors can take years. The process is 'difficult and opaque'.

items.raw_excerpt: Richie Mo'unga returns to New Zealand rugby for the first time in three years, starting on the bench in Canterbury's NPC opener against Auckland.
items.summary_en: Richie Mo'unga returns to New Zealand rugby for the first time in three years. He starts on the bench in Canterbury's NPC opener against Auckland. Fans will watch to see how the star player performs again at home.

items.raw_excerpt: The rollout of a program to recycle food and garden waste into compost across Canberra, originally due to be introduced in 2023, has been delayed a third time, with the ACT government now aiming to introduce the scheme by 2030.
items.summary_en: Canberra planned to recycle food and garden waste into compost. The rollout was first due in 2023. It has now been delayed a third time. The government hopes to start it by 2030.
items.summary_ko: 캔버라에서 음식물과 정원 쓰레기를 퇴비로 재활용하는 사업이 시작될 예정이었습니다. 원래 2023년 도입 예정이었지만 세 번째로 미뤄졌습니다. 지방정부는 이제 2030년까지 시행하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.title_en: Canberra food waste compost scheme delayed to 2030
